title: GET /push and PUT /push response
description: Push notifications on this server, for this phone. available is false when the server has no push key at all: the app says so and does not ask the phone for permission on this server's account. platforms says which half is configured (apns: iPhones and Live Activities; fcm: Android). events is every event a phone may ask for; registration is what this phone registered, or null. PUT refusals (error.schema.json): 400 bad_request, 422 bad_platform, bad_token, bad_environment, bad_events.

event.description: round_paired and round_published: the desk's acts. phone_result: a Manubrium Lite phone's result that disagrees with the hall board or with the result already entered. incident: one logged by somebody else. coarbiter_result: results another account entered, batched per half minute (off by default). default_time: the reminder the phone asked for (PUT /tournaments/:id/default-time).

environment.description: The APNs host the token belongs to: sandbox for a build from Xcode, production for TestFlight and the App Store. Always production for fcm.
